# Productboard MCP Usage Monitoring
Adoption metrics from the productboard MCP server (log group `/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP`). **Data begins when per-request usage logging shipped** (the access-log `user_email` / `mcp_method` / `tool_name` fields). Health-check traffic has no `user_email` and is auto-excluded from user metrics. **"tool calls"** = `mcp_method="tools/call"` (actual work); **"requests"** also includes `initialize` / `tools/list`. Adjust the time range at the top-right to change every widget.

properties.title: Active users (selected range)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter ispresent(user_email) | stats count_distinct(user_email) as active_users

properties.title: Tool calls (selected range)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as tool_calls

properties.title: Total MCP requests (selected range)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter path = "/mcp" | stats count(*) as requests

properties.title: Daily active users
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter ispresent(user_email) | stats count_distinct(user_email) as daily_active_users by bin(1d)

properties.title: Daily tool calls
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as tool_calls by bin(1d)

properties.title: Tool calls per user
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" and ispresent(user_email) | stats count(*) as tool_calls by user_email | sort tool_calls desc

properties.title: Tool popularity
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as calls by tool_name | sort calls desc

properties.title: Tool usage (by tool)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as calls by tool_name | sort calls desc | limit 100

properties.title: Server usage (by user)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as tool_calls by user_email | sort tool_calls desc | limit 100

properties.title: Request type mix (initialize / tools-list / tools-call)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter path = "/mcp" and ispresent(mcp_method) | stats count(*) as count by mcp_method

properties.title: Per-user tool usage (user x tool)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as calls by user_email, tool_name | sort calls desc | limit 100

properties.title: Recent tool calls
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/PRODUCTBOARD-MCP' | filter mcp_method = "tools/call" | fields @timestamp, user_email, tool_name, status, duration_ms | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100
